# DUCPT Skills

> Open source Agent Skills (SKILL.md) by DUCPT for one-person companies run with AI agents, with Vietnamese language support. MIT license. Install with `npx skills add ducdg88/ducpt-skills`.

Author: DUCPT, https://ducpt.com
Repository: https://github.com/ducdg88/ducpt-skills
Skill pages: https://ducpt.com/skills/

## Skills

- [one-person-company-ai](https://github.com/ducdg88/ducpt-skills/blob/main/skills/one-person-company-ai/SKILL.md): org chart of AI agent roles, ticket rules, daily loop, approval gates, KPI sheet.
- [vietnamese-transcript-cleaner](https://github.com/ducdg88/ducpt-skills/blob/main/skills/vietnamese-transcript-cleaner/SKILL.md): clean Vietnamese SRT, VTT or speech-to-text, summary and action items.
- [vietnamese-copy-polish](https://github.com/ducdg88/ducpt-skills/blob/main/skills/vietnamese-copy-polish/SKILL.md): lint and rewrite Vietnamese marketing copy per platform.
- [pinterest-pin-writer](https://github.com/ducdg88/ducpt-skills/blob/main/skills/pinterest-pin-writer/SKILL.md): Pinterest pin variants and bulk upload CSV.
- [youtube-title-lab](https://github.com/ducdg88/ducpt-skills/blob/main/skills/youtube-title-lab/SKILL.md): YouTube title candidates, scoring, thumbnail text, A/B plan.
- [knowledge-mindmap](https://github.com/ducdg88/ducpt-skills/blob/main/skills/knowledge-mindmap/SKILL.md): mind map, sourced summary, flashcards, spaced review.
- [windows-duplicate-cleanup](https://github.com/ducdg88/ducpt-skills/blob/main/skills/windows-duplicate-cleanup/SKILL.md): safe hash-based duplicate file cleanup with quarantine.
- [skill-distribution-kit](https://github.com/ducdg88/ducpt-skills/blob/main/skills/skill-distribution-kit/SKILL.md): package, validate, publish and measure agent skills.
- [github-commit-streak](https://github.com/ducdg88/ducpt-skills/blob/main/skills/github-commit-streak/SKILL.md): GitHub contribution streak and goal pace.
- [vietnamese-voice-dictionary](https://github.com/ducdg88/ducpt-skills/blob/main/skills/vietnamese-voice-dictionary/SKILL.md): persistent dictionary that fixes misheard Vietnamese dictation of technical words.
- [content-originality-check](https://github.com/ducdg88/ducpt-skills/blob/main/skills/content-originality-check/SKILL.md): score video and channel risk of inauthentic or mass-produced content before publishing.
